messages:
daria (PM): ok team, we need a clear plan for the new 'flagging sequencer' — ordering flag flips so we avoid hotspotting infra and customer surprises. thinking sequence + soft-landing windows + per-tenant opt-out.

sam (eng): thanks — high level: sequencer = single writer that serializes flag state changes and emits staged deltas to regions, with rate limits and backlog window. avoids thundering herd.

liam (sre): big +1. key req: sequencer must be able to backpressure and pause propagation to a region if a node pool shows elevated latency. fallback should be instant revert per-region.

nina (product): customers care about predictable exposure and rollback rules. propose: 3-phase rollout for flags that touch inference path: shadow -> micro-canary (0.5% of traffic) -> gradual (1%, 5%, 20%, 50%). each phase min 30m and automated health gates.

dashok (ops): for Dedicated customers we should allow pinning to 'no-sequencer' path (direct ops-controlled flips) — or at least a sequencer bypass for emergency. documented opt-out required.

sam (eng): implementation notes: sequencer state stored in ordered log (Kafka or internal queue). merge-diffs per-tenant. control-plane emits intents, data-plane acknowledges per-region. on fail, sequencer marks delta as "stalled".

liam (sre): health gates — key signals: p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU memory pressure, error-rate on generation calls, queue-depth. gate algorithm: if two signals cross thresholds in a 5m window -> pause propagation and alert #eng-oncall.

nina (product): A/B testing: need to support cohort assignment independent of rollout slices. e.g., A/B for quality evals vs production traffic. Sequencer should accept explicit cohort_map overrides for experiments.

sam (eng): agreed. API: POST /sequencer/apply with payload {flag, target_slices[], cohort_map?, rollout_plan_id}. small CLI tool for on-call to fast-fail a rollout with --revert.

deploy-bot: canary run started: rollout_plan_id=rp_20231112_01, region=eu-west-1, slice=0.5%

liam (sre): seeing slight p95 blip in eu-west-1 < 3m after start, currently +12% over baseline. sequencer paused propagation to eu-west-1 automatically. alert routed to oncall.

ashok (ops): good — what's the manual unpause flow? needs to be documented with ownership.

sam (eng): manual flow: oncall runs /sequencer/unpause {rollout_plan_id, region} with required justification. CLI records audit entry. fallback runbook: if unpause fails or latency persists -> revert flag to previous state with immediate propagation and create incident.

nina (product): can we make soft-landing policy per-feature? some features can have progressive degradation instead of full revert. need product flag param degrade_policy: [revert, degrade, throttle].

liam (sre): degrade options must be explicit: e.g., reduce max tokens, lower concurrency per-req, or serve from cheaper model variant; config must map feature->degrade actions.

ashok (ops): telemetry: sequencer emits events: plan_started, phase_transition, region_paused, region_resumed, phase_completed, plan_aborted. tie these to Console dashboards and automated runbooks.

sam (eng): storage: keep plan history for 90d, store deltas for audit. rollouts must be idempotent.

nina (product): launch criteria summary: 1) sequencer infra tested in two regions; 2) automated gates + default thresholds; 3) CLI/manual unpause/revert documented; 4) product-level degrade_policy supported; 5) telemetry onboarded to Console and alerts wired.

liam (sre): SLA guardrail: if more than 2 sequencer-originated region pauses within a 24h window for same plan -> escalate to executive ops and freeze further rollouts for that feature until postmortem.

ashok (ops): dependencies: feature-flag API, Console metrics, rollout audit table, oncall CLI creds. timeline?

daria (PM): proposal: 3-week delivery: week1 core sequencer + simple rollout + audit; week2 gates + per-region pause + CLI; week3 degrade_policy + Console telemetry + docs. will sync with Eng Lead.

nina (product): I'll draft customer comms and default thresholds for inference features.

sam (eng): will prototype queue + ack flow this week. share design doc in #eng-platform.

liam (sre): I'll draft gate thresholds and incident playbook.

ashok (ops): I'll enumerate Dedicated opt-out checklist and emergency bypass.

daria (PM): thanks — action items noted. we'll use this sequencer for upcoming model-switch rollout. please drop followups or blockers here. :thumbsup:
